scope: packaging only: freeze the MiniLM-L12-H384 student (seed 1 of the gidi-en backbone bake-off, picked by experiments/gidi-en-student-v4/protocol.json) INT8 encoder (type + target + value) with its tokenizer into one bundle that declares the whole-word target and value snaps and the WordPiece tokenizer. No training, no seed change, no architecture, tokenizer or vocabulary change, no threshold change. models/gidi-en-bakeoff*, models/gidi-en-v2* are not modified.
architecture: gidi-en-student-v4 seed 1: microsoft/MiniLM-L12-H384-uncased (MIT) derived 12x384 encoder (all 12 layers, FFN 1536, 33 position rows, vocabulary pruned to 20,500 uncased WordPiece rows, max_length 32), 40 epochs on silver labels (silver-train + labels-seed + consistent slang notes, 2,355 notes with silver value labels), type head (8 classes) + target BIO head + value BIO head (O/B-VALUE/I-VALUE, Linear(384, 3)), ONNX INT8 (dynamic, QInt8 weights).

seed_selection.rule: the better of the two bake-off MiniLM seeds by the dev-only composite declared in experiments/gidi-en-student-v4/protocol.json (seed 1: 0.8857, seed 2: 0.8747); seed 1 would also have won the tie fallback. No further training, no checkpoint selection.

label_provenance: silver-claude-clef-regex: there are no human labels for English. Every score is agreement with Claude, Clef and regex-scanner labels, not ground truth.
target_snap_rule: the decoded first target span is extended outward to whole words (maximal non-whitespace runs, edge punctuation of the extension trimmed), exactly gidi.inference.decode.snap_to_words; it is a post-processing step outside the ONNX graph.
value_decoding_rule: per-token argmax of value_logits over the non-special tokens, the span with the highest geometric-mean tag probability (ties to the earlier one), extended to whole words with the same snap as the target. Post-processing outside the ONNX graph, exactly what scripts/evaluate_en_value.py scored.
evaluation_sets_report_only: test (primary, secondary), dev, datasets/probe-en-slang and datasets/probe-en-genz are used only to report quality. Numbers: experiments/gidi-en-student-v4/report.md.
acceptance_gate: bundle reproducible (freeze_en_bundle --check byte-identical); every bundle file matches manifest.json
INT8 model is the ONNX that experiments/gidi-en-backbone-bakeoff/runs/minilm/seed1/results.json scored
release verify passes: hashes, runtime config, INT8 and FP32 smoke predictions
pnpm -C playground parity:en passes on the bundle (WordPiece tokenizer, value decode and snaps exact)
on_gate_failure: stop and report the blocker; no retraining, no seed change
